Title: Congress Stock Watcher Insights: ChatGPT, but for US congressional stock trades | Product Hunt
# Congress Stock Watcher Insights. ## ChatGPT, but for US congressional stock trades. Gain deep insight into congressional stock trades with Congress stock watcher Insights. Ask a simple question and get an answer in seconds. Stay up-to-date on your representative and senator's stock investments with ease. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Congress Stock Watcher Insights. **This is a beta tool currently - to get invited instantly include the promo-code in your application in the text field & we will send you an invite!** My name is Timothy Carambat, creator and maintainer of Senate Stock Watcher & House Stock Watcher where we maintain the most accurate and accessible congressional trade database. This hobby project has always been a public service for me that I am happy to provide but being that this isn't my full-time job I often don't have the ability to answer question inquiries like **"How many trades occurred this month?"** and asking people to go download and analyze the **30,000+** trades that have been recorded is a huge chore. If you are trying to keep up with your representative or senator's stock investments the tedious process of manually parsing through thousands of trades can now be skipped with Congress stock watcher Insights. We are the first to provide this kind of tool on a public dataset and are proud to offer this as another tool you can use. Sign up now and use promo code on this post in the text field on your beta application submission to get invited instantly! @tim\_carambat You have made progress, unlocked a new door, and completed a novel action. Hey @tim\_carambat 👋🏼 This is a fun project. Do you have any thoughts on other public data sets that you think would augment this tool? There probably aren't many easy ways to connect trades with legislation, but a nice start might be to roll up legislation and trades into broader economic sectors. Would really love to be clever and get trade returns, which is a very hard problem because the trades never match one to one with a buy/sell but I'm sure I can come up with something in time.
